newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BANK AUSTRIA KEEPS 'ACCUMULATION' ON MEZOGEP.
newsitem.headline: BANK AUSTRIA KEEPS 'ACCUMULATION' ON MEZOGEP.

text.p: Bank Austria Investment said it maintained its 'accumulate' recommendation on shares in Hungarian machinery company Mezogep Rt after its first-half earnings report.
"Though the share price includes a considerable premium compared to its sector and the market, Mezogep has a considerable growth potential," analyst Andrea Dicso said in an update.

Mezogep released its first-half results last week and reported its operating profits rising to 579 million forints from 282 million in the same period of 1996, while its sales surged to 3.404 billion forints from 1.830 billion.
Its earnings per share (EPS) rose to 75 forints in the first six months of 1997 from 71 forints in same months in 1996.

Bank Austria Investment did not change its profit forecast, even though the third quarter, which generally contributes 40 percent of Mezogep's total profit, is expected to be a very strong one due to seasonal fluctuations.
The analyst expected Mezogep's earnings per share to amount to 157.7 forints in 1997 and 204.8 forints in 1998.
